about.title: About Me
about.content: Backend-focused full-stack developer with 3+ years of experience at Bidec Solutions in Karachi, now working at mid-level. I build production REST APIs, real-time systems (WebSockets, Pusher, FCM), CMS and marketplace platforms with Laravel and NestJS, backed by MySQL and PostgreSQL. My work covers JWT/Sanctum authentication with role-based access control, service/repository architecture, query optimisation and indexing, queues and caching. I also work across the frontend with React and have built mobile-backed products, so I can contribute across the stack while keeping the backend as my core strength.

projects.name: Advertina Global - Digital Advertising Booking Platform
projects.description: Digital-advertising booking product delivered as three web projects: a NestJS and PostgreSQL API (booking, authentication, payments, media handling and background jobs), a Next.js customer site with a guest booking wizard and advertiser portal, and a Next.js staff panel with an operations console and reviewer desk. Requests pass through JWT auth, permission and resource-scope guards, and the API connects to GiguPlay as a partner to play booked campaigns on screens.

projects.name: GiguPlay - Multi-Tenant Screen Network Platform
projects.description: Multi-tenant platform for running video content on TV-box screens, built as three web projects plus a player app: a NestJS, TypeORM and PostgreSQL API with socket.io, a Next.js management panel for staff, a Next.js client panel for partners and customers, a public marketing site with plans and a buy flow, and an offline-first Flutter player backed by local SQLite. Includes screen time-sharing between partners, device pairing by QR code, two-factor authentication and role-based permissions.

projects.name: DevPay - Payment Gateway
projects.description: Engineered a comprehensive payment gateway prototype using Next.js and Supabase to simulate a complete financial ecosystem. This project features detailed API documentation and includes dedicated dashboards for Admins, Merchants, and Government Agents, showcasing my ability to design and build complex, multi-tenant systems with a focus on security and usability.

projects.name: Palmisland - Dubai Property Agency
projects.description: Developed an agency website for showcasing luxury properties in Dubai. The platform is built with a Laravel backend and React.js frontend, designed to provide an elegant and responsive user experience for property listings and client interactions.

projects.name: Ma3rood - E-commerce, Property & Motors Platform
projects.description: Built a comprehensive multi-category marketplace inspired by TradeMe (New Zealand) and tailored for the Dubai market. Ma3rood offers a full-fledged e-commerce system, property listings, and motors marketplace, providing users with a seamless platform to buy, sell, and explore diverse categories in one unified ecosystem.

projects.name: Ride_n_Share - Real-Time Ride Booking App
projects.description: Contributed to the development of a ride-booking mobile application with a Nest.js backend and React Native frontend. Specifically implemented WebSocket-based live communication to enable real-time ride requests, driver updates, and user notifications. This project demonstrates my ability to design and integrate scalable, low-latency communication systems within mobile applications, ensuring a smooth and interactive user experience.

projects.name: GetX Services - On-Demand Services App
projects.description: Developed a full-featured mobile marketplace for on-demand home services using Flutter and a NestJS backend. This comprehensive solution supports dual roles for users and service providers, and integrates Firebase for real-time notifications, showcasing my ability to build robust, cross-platform mobile applications from the ground up.

projects.name: LuxuryStay - Hotel Management System
projects.description: Solo-built MERN application covering room booking, housekeeping and cleaning workflows, automated room-status updates and the checkout flow, with a MongoDB data model and indexing on booking and room-status endpoints.

projects.name: Nehlum - NestJS CMS
projects.description: CMS with dynamic page creation and structured content, built on a modular NestJS architecture with PostgreSQL and REST APIs for frontend integration. Deployed and maintained live.

projects.name: Bidec Solutions - Corporate Website & CMS
projects.description: SEO-focused corporate website and CMS built with Laravel and MySQL. Includes clean URLs, metadata management, redirects and flexible content modules so non-technical users can publish and manage pages themselves.

projects.name: Portfolio OS
projects.description: The very operating system you are using now. A creative and interactive portfolio built to simulate a Kali Linux desktop environment. This project demonstrates my frontend skills and attention to detail, using Next.js, TypeScript, and Framer Motion to create a unique user experience.

experience.description: Lead Laravel and NestJS backend modules and design and document REST APIs using service/repository architecture. Implement JWT/Sanctum authentication with role-based access control, query tuning and indexing, caching and real-time features, and mentor junior developers and review code. Delivered Ma3rood, Ride n Share, the Bidec Solutions website, Nehlum CMS, and the Advertina Global and GiguPlay platforms.
